Here 0<p<1, so every finite history interval has positive length. There are finitely many intervals at each depth; endpoints and splits are explicit, and every point has one history at every depth. If I_{n+1} is its red indicator, R_{n+1}=R_n+c I_{n+1}. Hence E[R_{n+1}/(T_n+c)|F_n]=(R_n+c R_n/T_n)/(T_n+c)=R_n/T_n, with T_n=r+g+nc. The proportions are in [0,1], adapted and integrable.
